name: Stat card
description: A big number with a label, for proof points.
source:
Component(
  dsl: 1, id: "market/stat-card", name: "Stat card", kind: Kind.section,
  description: "A big number with a label, for proof points.",
  options: [StringOption(name: "value", label: "Number", maxLength: 12, default: "12 000+"), StringOption(name: "label", label: "Label", maxLength: 40, default: "orders delivered")],
  variants: [Variant(id: "default", label: "Default", build:
    Box(padding: Space.lg, radius: Radius.lg, background: Color.surfaceAlt, child: Column(gap: Space.xs, align: Align.center, children: [Text(child: options.value, size: FontSize.xxl, weight: FontWeight.bold, color: Color.primary), Text(child: options.label, color: Color.textMuted)]))
  )],
)
